description: Docked panel showing the document's version history. Lists saved versions with their metadata and offers create, preview, return-to-current, and restore (with confirmation) actions, and can render an inline diff of two selected versions via TmDocumentDiffViewer. Phase 7: the inline diff is gone; "Show differences" (disabled until Base and Compare are both picked) raises OnShowDiff with the picked pair and the editor opens the comparison mode of the document region.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the panel should close.

parameters.name: OnCreateVersion
parameters.description: Raised when the create-version dialog should open.

parameters.name: OnRestoreVersion
parameters.description: Raised when the previewed version should be restored.

parameters.name: OnReturnToCurrent
parameters.description: Raised when preview should return to the current document.

parameters.name: OnSelectVersion
parameters.description: Raised when a historical version should be previewed.

parameters.name: PreviewVersion
parameters.description: Version currently previewed by the editor.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether create actions should be disabled.

parameters.name: ShowClose
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own close button. Defaults to true; the editor passes false while the panel is hosted in the docked side panel, whose own close button already does the same thing (two X in one corner).

parameters.name: ShowPreviewStrip
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders the 'You are viewing version X' strip itself. Defaults to true; the editor shows the strip in the document region and passes false.

parameters.name: OnShowDiff
parameters.description: Raised with the picked Base and Compare versions when "Show differences" is pressed. The button is disabled until both sides are picked; the editor opens the comparison as a mode of the document region (the diff no longer renders inside this panel).
